title: The Training Grounds
blurb: Lay out a course, run it, and beat your own ghost.

steps.text: Place a Start Gate, numbered Checkpoint Rings and a Finish Gate.
steps.hint: Rings join the nearest Start Gate in the order you place them.
Step onto the start to begin. The clock holds at zero while you stand there.
Your best run is replayed as a ghost the next time you leave the start.

steps.text: Add a Target Dummy beside the course and strike it.
steps.hint: A dummy counts when it is struck or hit by your projectile.

finish.line: You have a course of your own.
